we have completed the calculation of all two-loop corrections to all the off-diagonal and diagonal elements of the anomalogous dimensions of the conformal operators in the Abeliangauge theory.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the conformal symmetry is broken at two-loop level by the same operators that break it at one-loop.
the two-loop corrections are not small in the conformal regime.
the two-loop evolution kernel is not a simple linear combination of the DGLAP functions.
